article_summaries.title: Free Realms - Quoi de neuf ? / Rencontre les Gardiens du Royaume
article_summaries.summary: SOE's French-language news post announces Heroes (Héros), a new expansion for the Free Realms Trading Card Game. It gives the expansion's story (Baron von Darkcheat, Madam Zelda and four child Guardians), the four Guardians' decks, weapons and vehicles, and three gameplay changes: multicolor gem boosts, stun-removal cards and stack-removal cards. The article gives no release date and no card counts.
